design: Compact older muscular courier with a heavy sloped brow, close-set four mandibles and a thick dreadlock beard-like side curtain that stops at the shoulders. Broad oval leather satchel hanging at front left, high sturdy collar, one small shoulder plate and layered rectangular skirt tabs. Right hand pulls a courier seal strap taut while left steadies satchel. Granite-grey spotted skin, bowed but confident head.
